description: Objective: To enhance the functionality of the Odoo ERP system by customizing existing modules and developing new ones, aiming to streamline business processes and improve operational efficiency.

Key responsibilities:
  • Analyzing business requirements and translating them into technical specifications.
  • Customizing base Odoo modules (Sales, Purchase, Manufacturing, Inventory, PLM, Helpdesk, Document…) to meet specific business needs.
  • Developing new modules and features to extend the functionality of the Odoo ERP system.
  • Integrating Odoo with third-party applications like Shopify.
  • Conducting thorough testing and quality assurance to ensure seamless integration and functionality.
  • Providing technical support and training to end-users.

Modules developed and customized:
  1. After-Sale Service (from Sales module):
    • RMA Orders: Developed a Return Merchandise Authorization system to manage returns efficiently, track returned items, and process refunds or replacements.
    • Order Cancellation: Implemented a feature allowing customers to cancel orders under certain conditions, with automated workflows for approval and processing.
    • RTS Order (Return to Sender): Created a system for handling return-to-sender cases, managing logistics, and updating inventory accordingly.
    • Dropship Refund Order: Developed a module to handle refunds for dropship orders, integrating with suppliers and automating the refund process.
    • Chargeback Order: Implemented a chargeback management system to handle disputed transactions, track status, and automate communications with payment processors.
  2. Forecasting System (from Manufacturing, Purchasing, PLM modules) developed a comprehensive forecasting module that:
    • Pre-issues Manufacturing Orders (MOs) and upcoming RFQs.
    • Estimates production time and resource allocation for MOs.
    • Automatically Kick-of the PLM (ECOs).
    • Generates detailed annual and monthly sales reports.
    • Sends automated forecasting notifications dynamically based on real-time data.
  3. Helpdesk module:
    • Auto Generate Tickets: Enabled automatic ticket generation via website forms from Shopify and through email.
    • Customized Helpdesk Overview: Created a personalized Helpdesk dashboard with sections for My Tickets, My Outbound Tickets, and Team Tickets.
    • Knowledge Base Integration: Added a feature to convert completed tickets into knowledge base articles.
    • Internal Ticket Rating: Implemented a rating system for internal tickets with options for Awesome, Accept, and Reject.
    • Employee KPI Report: Developed a module to track and report on employee Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
    • Recurring Tickets and Workflows: Set up recurring tickets and workflows based on the type of inquiry to streamline repetitive tasks.
  4. Document module:
    • NFC Renewal Document Management: Created a workflow for managing NFC renewal documents, ensuring secure and efficient handling of sensitive information.

Challenges Faced:
  • Ensuring seamless integration between customized modules and existing Odoo functionalities.
  • Managing complex business requirements and translating them into efficient technical solutions.
  • Handling data migration and ensuring data integrity during the customization process.

Achievements/Results:
  • Successfully customized and deployed multiple Odoo modules, significantly improving business processes.
  • Enhanced customer satisfaction through efficient after-sale service and automated helpdesk operations.
  • Improved forecasting accuracy and production planning, leading to better resource management and cost savings.
  • Streamlined document management processes, ensuring compliance and security.

Objective: To develop a comprehensive Odoo ERP system for Anh Minh Seafood company, specializing in seafood processing, manufacturing, and wage management. The system integrates IoT devices, biometric attendance, and advanced manufacturing workflows to optimize production processes and ensure traceability.

Key responsibilities:
  • Designed and developed several custom Odoo modules for seafood industry-specific requirements.
  • Integrated IoT scale devices via MQTT protocol for real-time weight measurement.
  • Implemented biometric attendance system using Ronald Jack FA2000 devices.
  • Developed complex wage calculation system with multiple calculation methods.
  • Created seafood-specific lot management with fishing vessel tracking and EUCC certification.
  • Enhanced manufacturing workflows with yield tracking and byproduct management.
  • Implemented REST API endpoints for external system integration.
  • Provided technical support and training to end-users.

Modules developed and customized:
  1. IoT & Device Integration:
    • Scale Management: Integrated electronic scales via MQTT protocol for real-time weight measurement, automatic product deduction, and live dashboard monitoring.
    • REST API Odoo: Developed RESTful API endpoints for external system communication with GET/POST/PUT/DELETE operations.
    • Ronald Jack FA2000 Attendance: Integrated biometric attendance devices using ZKTeco SDK protocol (UDP/TCP) with automatic attendance sync and fingerprint management.
  2. Manufacturing & Production:
    • Custom Manufacturing: Enhanced manufacturing orders with employee tracking, equipment quantity logs, material loss tracking, performance metrics, and productivity reports.
    • Custom Seafood MRP: Seafood-specific manufacturing with yield tracking per operation, intermediate product flows, daily production logs, byproduct management, and QR label generation.
    • Custom MRP Equipment: Equipment integration in manufacturing orders and BOMs with work center assignment.
    • Custom MRP: Manufacturing and payroll management with custom reports and labor cost tracking.
  3. Seafood-Specific Features:
    • Custom Seafood Lot: Lot management with fishing vessel information, catch areas, fishing dates, landing ports, EUCC certificates, QR code generation and printing.
    • Custom Seafood Reports: Custom reports for seafood inventory, stock picking, and daily production summaries.
  4. Wage & HR Management:
    • Custom Seafood Wage: Production wage calculation system supporting 4 methods: Input Team (by raw material), Output Team (by finished product), Individual Scale (by weight), and Team Scale (shared weight). Includes RFID-based employee check-in, daily wage summaries, allowance management, and export wizards.
    • Custom Employee Transfer: Employee transfer management in manufacturing orders with RFID tracking, department assignment, and transfer history.
  5. Asset & Inventory:
    • Asset Management: Complete asset lifecycle management with depreciation calculation, maintenance tracking, transfer management, warranty monitoring, and financial reporting.
    • Custom Low Stock Alert: Automated low stock alerts with configurable rules per product category and automatic activity creation for assigned users.
  6. Reporting & Analytics:
    • Custom Pivot Report: Dynamic pivot report generator for any Odoo model without coding requirements.

Challenges Faced:
  • Integrating diverse IoT devices (scales, biometric devices) with different protocols (MQTT, ZKTeco SDK).
  • Developing complex wage calculation algorithms with multiple methods and real-time RFID integration.
  • Managing seafood-specific traceability requirements (fishing vessel, catch areas, EUCC certification).
  • Handling real-time data synchronization between IoT devices and Odoo ERP.
  • Ensuring data accuracy in yield tracking and byproduct management.

Achievements/Results:
  • Successfully deployed several custom modules, creating a comprehensive ERP system for seafood processing.
  • Automated wage calculation process, reducing calculation time by 80% and eliminating errors.
  • Implemented real-time scale integration, improving production accuracy and reducing material waste.
  • Enhanced traceability with fishing vessel tracking and EUCC certification management.
  • Streamlined attendance management with biometric device integration.
  • Improved production planning with yield tracking and byproduct management.
